title: Parallel Resistors
text: In parallel, resistors provide alternative paths for current. The combined resistance is less than any individual resistor because current has more paths to take.

title: Parallel Formula
text: 1/Rp = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + ... For two resistors, this simplifies to Rp = (R₁×R₂)/(R₁+R₂), called 'product over sum'.

title: Series Resistors
